pages.text: Build a $(l:basics/recipes)Rune Stone$() frame like a Nether portal: inside from $(thing)2×3$() to $(thing)21×21$(), corners are optional.$(br2)Right-click the frame with a $(item)Sanctum Shard$() (used up) to light it.

Step into the portal and pick a $(l:raid/difficulties)difficulty$(): the Sanctum is generated over a few seconds.$(br2)After the collapse, that portal has to recharge ($(thing)30 min$()). Every portal is independent: build another one to go again right away.$(br2)Portal ruins also exist in the world.
pages.title: Recharge
